witness.heading: MechanicalWorkflows is an ordinary function library
witness.sentence: CACWorkflowCompositionV0 is design-only (the MechanicalWorkflows cac-workflow-composition-2026-10-18 program states it as a concept only, with no released schema or type), and no Pi surface consumes it; when a release ships it and a Pi surface consumes it, Pi carries each step and source-artifact ID only as a native reference equal to the producer's own ID, counts a step or source without one as an unmapped entry, and never mints a Beads task ID, a Forge operation or gate ID, or a Furnace Attempt ID from composition fields.
